configurations.name: db-ui-check
runtimeArgs: import os, uvicorn; os.environ['DATABASE_URL'] = 'sqlite:///data/check/subscriptions-check.db'; uvicorn.run('app.main:app', port=8011)

configurations.name: db-ui-refresh-test
runtimeArgs: import os, pathlib, uvicorn; os.environ['DATABASE_URL'] = 'sqlite:///data/check/subscriptions-refresh.db'; from app import config, refresh; config.REPORT_DIR = pathlib.Path('data/check/reports').resolve(); refresh.PATHS = refresh.Paths(source=pathlib.Path('data/check/source').resolve(), backups=pathlib.Path('data/check/backups').resolve(), reports=config.REPORT_DIR); uvicorn.run('app.main:app', port=8012)
